parameters.name: DBInstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID. Call the DescribeDBInstances operation to query instance IDs.

parameters.name: Operation
parameters.description:
The operation to perform. Valid values:

- RETRY\_IMPORT: Retries the data import task.

- CANCEL: Cancels the data import task.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID. Call the DescribeRegions operation to query the latest list of regions.
